subject: general
question: Gandhiji founded Harijan Sevak Sangh in _______ to eradicate untouchability and uplift the depressed classes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1932.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 The All India **Harijan Sevak Sangh**, popularly known as the** All India Anti-Untouchability League, **is an **independent **national-level non-profit voluntary **organisation**.
 
 
• 
 It was established on **September 30, 1932,** following **Gandhiji's Epic Fast **at **Yervada Jail**, Pune, which led to the historic Poona Pact.
 
 
• 
 In order to fight untouchability, the **Sangh **was founded, and the Harijan, a new weekly newspaper, was launched.
 
 
• 
 The organisation has assisted the underprivileged classes in numerous ways ever since it was **founded**.
 
 
• 
 The Sangh performed** inter-dining** and** inter-caste marriages** and assisted the underprivileged classes in gaining access to public facilities like temples, schools, roads, and water resources.
 
 
• 
 **Numerous schools **and **hostels **across the nation were built by Harijan Sevak Sangh, and they are still in operation today.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The recent historical context begins with Gandhiji's opposition to the **Hindu community's **untouchables being divided into a distinct **electoral bloc **during the **Second Round Table Conference** in London in 1931.
 
• He thought that the British were prepared to do this in order to **fracture **the **Hindu community **and pursue their** evil divide-and-conquer strategy.**
 
• Gandhi began his death-defying fast at **Yervada **Jail in Pune on **September 20, 1932,** awakening Indians' consciences to the horrible practise of untouchability.
 
• He broke his fast on** September 24, 1932**, but only after receiving assurances from Hindu leaders over the matter and the **Poona Pact's **acceptance.
